run_descriptor_tests: run the protobuf descriptor unit tests to verify descriptor pool and message descriptor behavior
test_descriptor_pool: test the descriptor pool by adding serialized file descriptors and finding messages by name
test_custom_options: test custom options on file, message, field, enum, and service descriptors using GetOptions
test_copy_to_proto: test copying descriptor objects to their corresponding proto classes like DescriptorProto and FileDescriptorProto
test_feature_inheritance: test feature inheritance across file, message, enum, field, oneof, and service descriptors
